bounded_question: Which reversible attachment + maintenance interface mechanism best preserves P02's standing/half-lean relation while making removal, buffer replacement, drainage/cleaning and passage priority legible?

alternatives.mechanism: two independent compact clamp pods with replaceable isolation liners and outward service fasteners
alternatives.benefit: small affected rail area and local part replacement
alternatives.risk: higher part count and more discrete point interfaces

alternatives.mechanism: single removable rear bridge/backplate spanning two rail interfaces with continuous clean-out gap
alternatives.benefit: strong assembly/readability and centralized service access
alternatives.risk: broad contact zone may collect dirt/water and read visually heavy

alternatives.mechanism: paired split collars on existing vertical rail posts with short brackets to contact surface
alternatives.benefit: clear paired service points without a continuous rear plate
alternatives.risk: depends on post spacing and may increase passage-side projection
